item.title: Version 1.7.0-beta (89)
item.description:
Trails RG Studio 1.7.0-beta

Build 89

  • Crop can export a real size in pixels, inches, or centimetres.
  • Grid lines can be Thirds, Grid, Diagonal, Golden, or none.
  • On a phone, Adjust opens one job at a time. Hold for original, Compare, and Save edit sit under the photo.
